snippet.title: Dorotea • A Game Boy Horror Story indie homebrew game • Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#retrogaming #gameboy #indiegame 
Dorotea is an horror Game Boy experience. Play it now for free on Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Super Game Boy, Windows  PC, HTML5 Browser Web and Xbox Series X | S
🟥 https://pasquiindustry.com/dorotea
🟥 https://pasquiindustry.itch.io/dorotea

🟥 https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/dorotea/9N2J4VXC7WXJ

## Incipit ## 
Dorotea is a researcher specializing in the history of her hometown of Conversano, near Bari
An important event is just a few days away. Her job involves cataloging and archiving books and artifacts dating back to the 1600s, stored in a room that hasn't been opened for decades.
But the past never stops watching her...
